$$
x=3 \sin{\left(t \right)},\quad y=\cos{\left(t \right)},\quad z=t^{2}.
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t)) & =\left(y\right)\,i+\left(- x\right)\,j+\left(z\right)\,k \\ & =\left(\cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(- 3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(t^{2}\right)\,k\end{aligned}

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t))\cdot r^{\prime}(t) & =\left(\left(\cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(- 3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(t^{2}\right)\,k\right)\cdot\left(\left(3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(- \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\,j+\left(2 t\right)\,k\right) \\ & =\left(\cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\cdot\left(3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(- 3 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\cdot\left(- \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(t^{2}\right)\cdot\left(2 t\right) \\ & =\left(3 \cos^{2}{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(3 \sin^{2}{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(2 t^{3}\right) \\ & =2 t^{3} + 3\end{aligned}
